* Product Management experience in e-commerce, B2B/B2C marketplaces, or digital consumer products (6+ years)

* Data-driven product initiatives and experimentation
* Understanding of AI product lifecycle concepts

* AI/ML
* Generative AI
* E-commerce
* B2B/B2C marketplaces
* Digital consumer products
* Product management
* Commerce mechanics
* Analytics tools
* Data-driven product initiatives
* Experimentation
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Agile environments
* Technical acumen

* The job description implies that the candidate should have a strong understanding of the e-commerce industry and its challenges.
* The mention of "hands-on experience with analytics tools" suggests that the candidate should be able to analyze data and use it to inform product decisions.
* The phrase "ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders" implies that the candidate should be able to build strong relationships with various teams and stakeholders.
* The requirement of "team handling experience" suggests that the candidate should be able to manage and lead a team, which may not be explicitly stated but is an important aspect of the role.
* The mention of "AI product lifecycle concepts" and "AI-enabled user experiences" implies that the candidate should have a deep understanding of AI and its applications in product development.
